Finite.text: Whether a point has real coordinates (neither NaN nor infinite); used when probing geometry for impossible values.
Finite.returns: True if both coordinates are finite numbers

ProbeObject.text: Test helper: exercises an object's geometry (bounding box, hit tests on its own points, rotation invariants) and counts anything impossible or unexplained into Stats.

params.Where: description of where the object came from, for messages

CRound.text: Rounds to nearest, halves away from zero, as C does (used to compare with the C++ pin layout).

Near.text: Whether two points differ by no more than a tolerance on each axis.

Note.text: Counts a finding and prints the first 40 of them.

ProbePlaced.text: Test helper: checks a placed symbol against the C++ rules (draw path versus netlist path agree on every pin, rotation moves pins rigidly, pins are hit, pins lie in the box, replacing a symbol with itself moves nothing) and updates the statistics.

params.Where: where the symbol came from, for messages

TResourceItem.Create.text: Creates a resource entry that is not yet numbered, not in use, and not merged.

TResourceList.Create.text: Creates a list of resources (fonts, line styles or fill styles) whose first entry is the default one.

TResourceList.Destroy.text: Frees the list and its entries.

TResourceList.Add.text: Adds a resource, reusing an equal entry that has not been merged yet (CDocResource::Add); otherwise appends it with the next free number.
TResourceList.Add.returns: the number of the entry that now represents it

params.NewItem: the resource to add (the list takes it or frees it if a duplicate)
params.NewMerge: merge number for resources loaded from a file, -1 for new ones

TResourceList.ConvertOld.text: Converts a number read from a file to this sheet's number for the same resource; unknown numbers give the default entry (0).

params.OldId: the number as written in the file

TResourceList.Get.text: The entry with a given number, or the default entry if there is none.

TResourceList.Tag.text: Marks the entry with that number as in use so it is saved.

TResourceList.UnTag.text: Marks every entry as not in use (done before tagging what an object uses, so unused ones are not saved).

TResourceList.ResetMerge.text: Forgets which file entries have been matched, ready for loading another file.

TResourceList.SaveXML.text: Writes every in-use entry as an element named TagName, each with its number.

TResourceList.LoadItemXML.text: Reads one saved entry and adds it to the list, remembering its file number so objects can refer to it.

params.R: the XML reader on the entry

TFontResource.Create.text: Creates a font entry with the standard text height and default face.

TFontResource.CreateSized.text: Creates a font entry with a given height and optionally italic.

TFontResource.Compare.text: Whether another font entry is identical (height, width, weight, italic, underline, strike-out, character set, face name).

TFontResource.WriteItem.text: Writes the font's fields as child elements.

TFontResource.ReadItem.text: Reads the font's fields from its child elements.

params.R: the XML reader on the entry

TLineStyleResource.Create.text: Creates a line style entry: solid, thickness 1, black.

TLineStyleResource.CreateWith.text: Creates a line style entry with the given dash style, thickness and color.

TLineStyleResource.Compare.text: Whether another line style is identical.

TLineStyleResource.WriteItem.text: Writes style, thickness and color as child elements.

TLineStyleResource.ReadItem.text: Reads style, thickness and color from child elements.

params.R: the XML reader on the entry

TFillStyleResource.Create.text: Creates a fill entry with no fill (index -1).

TFillStyleResource.CreateWith.text: Creates a fill entry with a hatch index and color.

params.AIndex: -1 none, 0 solid, 1 and up the hatch patterns

TFillStyleResource.Compare.text: Whether another fill style is identical.

TFillStyleResource.WriteItem.text: Writes index and color as child elements.

TFillStyleResource.ReadItem.text: Reads index and color from child elements.

params.R: the XML reader on the entry

TFontList.CreateItem.text: Makes an empty font entry for the loader.

TLineStyleList.CreateItem.text: Makes an empty line style entry for the loader.

TFillStyleList.CreateItem.text: Makes an empty fill style entry for the loader.

TUserColors.Create.text: Creates the set of sheet colors with TinyCAD's defaults.

TUserColors.Init.text: Resets every user color to its default (wire blue, bus red, junction, pin, power, and so on).

TUserColors.SetColor.text: Changes the color for a purpose.

TUserColors.TagNameOf.text: The XML element name used to save a color id.

TUserColors.ReadXML.text: Reads one color element if its name is a known color tag.
TUserColors.ReadXML.returns: True if the tag was a color and was read

TUserColors.WriteXML.text: Writes every user color, in id order.

TDetails.Create.text: Creates the page details with TinyCAD's defaults (A4 landscape page, title block fields empty, sheets "1 of 1") and no border, history or auto numbering.

NormalizeNewlines.text: Turns CRLF and CR into LF, because XML readers do, so notes round-trip exactly.
NormalizeNewlines.returns: the text with LF line ends

TDetails.AddRevision.text: Appends a revision (label, date, author, approver, notes) to the sheet's history.

TDetails.EffectiveRevision.text: The current revision: the last history entry's label, or the old single Revision field when there is no history.

TDetails.EffectiveRevisionDate.text: The date of the current revision (last history entry), or the last-change date when there is no history.

TDetails.BorderRectangle.text: The border rectangle for this sheet's page size and margin.

TDetails.ReadXML.text: Reads the DETAILS element: page size, title block fields, shown flags, date, and the additions (automatic sheet numbers, border, revision history). The grid element is passed on to Snap.

TDetails.WriteXML.text: Writes the DETAILS element. Automatic sheet numbers, border and revision history are only written when they are used, so ordinary files stay unchanged.

TDocOptions.Create.text: Creates a sheet's options, including its symbol table.

TDocOptions.Destroy.text: Frees the symbol table and the options.

TDocOptions.UnTagAll.text: Marks fonts, styles, fills and symbols as unused before a save.

TDocOptions.ResetMerge.text: Forgets merge matching of fonts, styles, fills and symbols before loading another file.

TDocOptions.AddSymbol.text: Adds a symbol to the sheet's symbol table (sharing an identical one already there).
TDocOptions.AddSymbol.returns: the symbol number to use in placed symbols

TDocOptions.SymbolInfo.text: The symbol data for a symbol number.

TDocOptions.NewSymbolNumber.text: Converts a symbol number from a file to this sheet's number.

params.OldId: the number as written in the file

TDocOptions.TagSymbol.text: Marks a symbol as in use so it is saved.

TDocOptions.TagSymbolContents.text: Marks the fonts, styles and fills used inside a symbol's drawing for a part, so they are saved with it.

TDocOptions.HasOrigin.text: Whether the sheet has a user-set origin.
TDocOptions.HasOrigin.returns: True if an origin is set

TDocOptions.WriteXML.text: Writes the OPTIONS element: grid settings, origin and colors.

TDocOptions.ReadXML.text: Reads the OPTIONS element, starting from default colors.

TDesignSheet.Create.text: Creates an empty sheet with its own options, details and drawing list.

TDesignSheet.Destroy.text: Frees the drawing and the options.

TDesignSheet.LoadXML.text: Reads a whole sheet (details, options, resources, objects) from its TinyCAD element.
TDesignSheet.LoadXML.returns: True if the sheet has any objects

params.R: the XML reader on the element

TDesignSheet.LoadXMLInto.text: Reads a sheet's content into a given list, optionally with the details block and in library-editing mode; unknown elements are skipped.
TDesignSheet.LoadXMLInto.returns: True if any object was read

params.EditLibrary: True when reading a library symbol

TDesignSheet.Snap.text: The sheet's grid and snap settings.

TDesignSheet.UpdateLayout.text: Recalculates the layout of every object on the sheet (text boxes, pin text).

TDesignSheet.SaveXML.text: Writes the sheet as a TinyCAD element with details and resources.

TDesignSheet.SaveXMLEx.text: Writes the sheet with choices: details block, fonts/styles/fills, and the origin object. Only the resources the objects use are written.

params.SaveResources: write the fonts, styles and fills
params.SaveOriginObject: write the origin as an object (library symbols)

TSymbolDocument.Create.text: Creates an empty symbol document (one sheet per part).

TSymbolDocument.AddSheet.text: Adds a part sheet in library-editing mode (pins of other parts hidden).

TSymbolDocument.LoadXML.text: Reads a symbol (all its parts) from XML.

params.Hetero: whether the parts have different drawings

TSymbolDocument.SaveXML.text: Writes a symbol (all its parts) as XML, writing only the resources it uses.

TSymbolDocument.LoadFromBlob.text: Reads a symbol from the text stored in a library record.

TSymbolDocument.SaveToBlob.text: Writes the symbol as the text stored in a library record.

LoadLibrarySymbolBlob.text: Loads a library symbol's drawing into a sheet's symbol data, merging its fonts, styles and fills.
LoadLibrarySymbolBlob.returns: True if the blob was read

params.Target: the sheet it is loaded into
params.Blob: the symbol text from the library

TDesignFile.AddSheet.text: Adds an empty sheet at the end.

TDesignFile.LoadFromStream.text: Loads a design from a stream: a single sheet file, or a multi-sheet file (TinyCADSheets). A single sheet with no objects is rejected unless AllowEmptySheets is set.

TDesignFile.MaxObjectId.text: The highest object id on any sheet (0 when none have one).

TDesignFile.NextObjectId.text: A new object id that is higher than any in use and higher than any given out this session, so deleted objects' ids are never reused.

TDesignFile.AssignIds.text: Gives an id to every object that has none.

TDesignFile.FixDuplicateIds.text: After the first, objects sharing an id (e.g. pasted copies) are given fresh ones.

TDesignFile.FindObject.text: Finds an object by its id on any sheet.

params.SheetIndex: set to the sheet it is on (-1 if not found)

TDesignFile.LoadFromFile.text: Loads a design from a file and remembers its name.

TDesignFile.SaveToStream.text: Writes the design as XML: a single sheet as TinyCAD, several as TinyCADSheets; resources are re-tagged first so only used ones are written.

TDesignFile.SaveToFile.text: Writes the design to a file and remembers its name.
